request:
Saarbrücken-HD is a German pathological-voice dataset containing clinically validated voice-disorder labels. HD means hyperfunctional dysphonia (212 healthy, 212 pathological). 
All recordings correspond to the sentence \textit{``Guten Morgen, wie geht es Ihnen?'' (``Good morning, how are you?'')} Keep the spoken content and evaluate all methods to summarize what works for this task.
reflections: formant_lpc: The user requests anonymization of German pathological voice recordings, skips masking, and asks to compare all methods. Prior experience suggests formant_lpc, formant_spec, and pitch better retain pathological cues than NeuralVC or Resyn. Run all available conversion methods in sequence and evaluate. Set with_mask to false for each conversion.
